bearerAuth.description: Frontal API key authentication. Provide your opaque API key (prefix `frt_`) as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer frt_...`. The platform edge validates the key and exchanges it for a short-lived internal JWT; clients never see or handle JWTs.
